name: The Seven Relics of ill Omen
description: Adapted from the novel The Seven Relics of ill Omen by Weiyu. In ancient times, a mysterious substance descended upon Fengzi Ridge. Capable of parasitic invasion, it twists the human heart and lures its host into evil. Now, these relics of ill omen have reemerged, unleashing a series of bizarre and gruesome murders. Five ordinary yet passionate young people—Mu Dai, Luo Ren, Thirteen-Thousand, Yan Hongsha, and Cao Yanhua—are successively drawn into this crisis through their own fateful encounters. They form the "Phoenix Squad" and embark on a perilous quest to subdue these ill omens. Amid life-and-death trials, Luo Ren and Mu Dai heal each other's wounds and forge a genuine bond. Through a long and arduous journey fraught with danger, the five overcome relentless challenges, their friendship tempered and deepened in the fires of adversity.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Grisly murders once rocked Luoma Lake. Now, decades later, Mu Dai travels to Wujiang to meet an informant with new details on the cold case.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After meeting him on the way to Wujiang, Mu Dai teams up with Cao Yanhua to trail a man looking into the Luoma Lake case and gets another lead.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While pressing Luo Ren about his interest in the case, Mu Dai discovers a shocking link between him, the Xiaoshang River incident and her boss.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Madam Hong shares what she knows about the Luoma Lake murders, she recalls a crucial run-in and reveals her motive for investigating.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: When Luo Ren's cousin gets violent, Mu Dai notices something unusual on her skin. Thirteen-Thousand tries to get time off work for him and Cao Yanhua.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After getting Pingting medical help, Mu Dai and the others battle the parasite while avoiding infection. Luo Ren's reckless decision angers Mu Dai.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Thirteen-Thousand goes with Luo Ren to his village, convinced it holds answers to the ill omen. Mu Dai applies to be a treasure hunter's bodyguard.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While Mu Dai and Hongsha recover from their injuries, the group sets up camp together. Feeling left out, Cao Yanhua wonders if he's being replaced.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A mutated clam attacks Cao Yanhua, prompting a rescue. As the group considers the presence of a dark relic, Mu Dai asks Luo Ren an intimate question.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In Mighty Kun's lab, the team makes a significant breakthrough in their fight against the parasites. Mu Dai grows uneasy over her missing memories.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Luo Ren and the crew race to reach Mu Dai as she accompanies Hongsha and Grandfather Yan through the mountains — and unknowingly into danger.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Luo Ren confronts Hongsha's grandfather and gets a disturbing confession. The team sets off again, but an alarming encounter forces them to split up.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While Mighty Kun researches an ancient legend that could help stop the ill omens, Thirteen-Thousand and Cao Yanhua get valuable intel from their captor.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Thirteen-Thousand joins Hongsha in the mountains, while the rest rush to deliver the relic to Mighty Kun. Mu Dai and Luo Ren discuss their feelings.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The team uncovers another relic while searching for Mu Dai. Luo Ren learns the truth behind Mu Dai's personality shifts from Madam Hong.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When a darker side of herself takes over, Mu Dai flees Lixi and saves a woman who offers her both a job and a chance at a new life in return.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Accused of murder, Mu Dai seeks out Luo Ren to help her escape, but he urges her to stay and investigates, soon finding a link to the mysterious letter.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: With Ma Chao's information, Thirteen-Thousand joins the squad to investigate the murder case framing Mu Dai, which may be tied to a mysterious relic.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: After learning Xiang Silan's true identity, a distraught Mu Dai flees as her friends try to comfort her. Luo Ren presses their captive for more intel.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: After receiving a suspicious message, Cao Yanhua heads to his hometown to look for a friend. The others follow when they can't contact him.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: While meeting an old colleague, Luo Ren learns someone from his past has returned. Mu Dai falls into a trap while searching for a cellphone signal.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: After Luo Ren escapes Yafeng's trap and reunites with Mu Dai, they piece together Qingshan's plans, Hongsha arrives in time to save Thirteen-Thousand.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Hongsha notices a suspicious item during the wedding and tries to lure out the relic. Meanwhile, Mu Dai and Luo Ren continue exploring the caves.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Thirteen Thousand confronts Qingshan in a lake, suspecting he's possessed. Mu Dai and Luo Ren hypnotize Yafeng to learn what she knows about the relics.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: When her master falls ill, Mu Dai plans to visit with Cao Yanhua, but Luo Ren insists on going with her after hearing of a threat to her safety.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Mu Dai finally reaches her martial arts master, who decides if Cao Yanhua is worthy to join the sect. Meanwhile, Luo Ren fears Leopard's next move.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After making an upsetting discovery in the mountains, Luo Ren, Cao Yanhua and Mingshan get a threatening call from Leopard that forces them to split up.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: As Luo Ren faces an old enemy, Aoki makes a hard choice. The rest of the team make plans to retrieve an artifact that can repel the omens.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: While Leopard presses Mu Dai for more information, the rest of the team searches for the items needed to seal the relics — but they may not be alone.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: With Luo Ren reeling from his injuries, the rest of the group joins the fight as Thirteen-Thousand and Aoki chase after the relic.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Master Kun helps the team decipher the meaning of their confusing vision, and they face the difficult truth of what it may cost them to seal the relics.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Mu Dai chooses between changing the painful parts of her past or keeping her life as is, and learns a crucial truth about the relic sealing ritual.
